name: model-finder
description: Find the cheapest AI model that passes your own tests: audit the models your repo uses, draft evals from your prompts, measure quality, latency and cost with your keys, generate cheapest-first routing, and size local models. Includes a local MCP server; nothing is sent to Indigloo.

defaultPrompt: Audit which AI models this repo uses and where they are hard-coded.
Test whether a cheaper model passes on our prompts before we switch.
Will this open-weight model fit on my GPU at 32k context?
interface.longDescription: Find the cheapest AI model that passes your own tests. A local MCP server audits the AI models and SDKs your repository uses, drafts eval examples from your prompt files (dropping anything with personal data or secrets), builds and validates eval configs, ranks results by cost per passing answer, generates cheapest-first routing with a LiteLLM config, and estimates token cost and local model memory. Evals run with your own keys via a standard-library Python script. Nothing is deployed, your active model is never changed, and nothing is sent to Indigloo.

publication.release_notes: 1.3.3: MCP launch config moved to mcp/plugin-mcp.json; evaluation fixture restored. 1.3.2: Codex now starts the bundled MCP server (Agent Plugins mcp.json) and tools ask for the project path when the host gives none. 1.3.1: privacy notice, terms and support now live in the plugin repository; no dependency on a separate website. 1.3.0: local MCP server with 10 read-only tools wired into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI.
